description: This file defines a React functional component for a dashboard page in a Next.js application. It fetches dashboard-related data (like defect stats and analytics) asynchronously and renders various UI components including charts, badges, and buttons based on the data loading state. It also includes navigation links to defect creation and listing pages.

methods.name: DashboardPage
methods.description: Main React component that displays the dashboard interface, fetches data on mount, and manages UI states.
